title: Adversarial Water-Filling: Theory, Algorithms, and a Domain-Specific Wireless Foundation Model
summary: Competitive resource allocation problems over frequency and space can be formulated as minimax interaction between transmit power and worst-case interference. This formulation naturally arises in multi-operator low Earth orbit (LEO) satellite spectrum sharing, where transmissions from competing constellations interfere in real-time. Under Gaussian channels, the corresponding power-allocation problem admits a convex-concave formulation with a unique saddle point.
